'''Findal Kett''' was the head of [[Kett Shipping]], a company that carried [[Ore/Legends|ore]] and [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cotellier/Legends|Cotellier]] in the [[Rseik sector/Legends|Rseik sector]] up the [[Sanrafsix Corridor]] to [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]], and then [[Grain/Legends|grain]] and other supplies back to Cotellier.

==Biography==
In [[214 BBY]], the [[Bordal Contagion]], a [[Death/Legends|deadly]] plague that filled beings' [[Lung/Legends|lungs]] with fluid and killed them, broke out in the [[Rseik sector/Legends|Rseik sector]]. Findal Kett's company, [[Kett Shipping]], carried shipments of an antidote to the [[Disease/Legends|disease]] from [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]], but six million doses were ruined when the ships were attacked by the [[Fujari]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. After this incident, the [[Rseikharhl]] began manufacturing the antidote in their own labs, but they, together with Findal Kett and the [[Ma'ar Shaddam Weaponsmiths Guild]], negotiated their entries into the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], who aided them against the Fujari. By the time Findal's great-great-great grandson, [[Firmus Kett]], led Kett Shipping, the Trade Federation had restored order to the Rseik and [[Tamarin sector/Legends|Tamarin]] [[Sector/Legends|sectors]], but controlled Kett Shipping's trade of [[Ore/Legends|ore]] and [[Nova crystal/Legends|crystals]], as well as [[Spice/Legends|spice]].<ref name="TEGTWAC" />
